# ResultGate

Local evidence validation and opt-in provider discovery / consented specialist task delegation.
This branch is an unreleased pilot, not a hosted agent network or A2A server.

- [Network onboarding and operation](docs/NETWORK.md)
- [Delegation and limitations](docs/DELEGATION.md)
- [Brokerage](docs/BROKERAGE.md)
- [Discovery metadata (custom, not an A2A card)](docs/network-discovery.json)
- [Commission opportunities under review](docs/COMMISSION-PARTNERS-2026-10-21.md)

No payments enabled. No proven independent use or earnings. Never submit private content or credentials in provider metadata. Submission does not grant trust or execution rights.
